title: Arc header
description: A 100px pinned header on the hero's pale grey: a bold lowercase wordmark left, three medium-weight warm-grey links centred, a log-in link and a 2px outlined button right. Over the first 100px of scroll it turns to the page colour and gains a wide soft shadow; links darken and the button floods with the primary colour on hover. On phones: wordmark and a menu icon that opens a full-width panel.
notes: sticks to the top of the page (position: sticky), so it needs to sit directly in the page container
the grey-to-white change follows the page scroll (CSS scroll timeline); without support or with reduced motion it stays grey
the phone menu is a native <details>; no JavaScript
